flavor.phonemic_palette: germanic (norse: the longship-folk; nominative -r, w- lost before round vowels (Wod->Od-), ai>ei, i/u-umlaut, -son/-dottir, the konungr/jarl/godi register, the dithematic Thor-/Gunn-/-ulfr name-stock) / north_american (woodland: Iroquoian/Haudenosaunee register, labial-free, the longhouse-clans (kanonhsa / ohwachira), the kanata-towns, the royaner/hoyaneh sachem ranks and the clan-mothers (Iakoia:ner), the forest substrate (karhakonha) and the totemic clan-powers)

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore): Lawful venerates the Lawful powers and names the Chaotic as demons; Chaotic the reverse; Neutral honors ancestral and local powers, invoking the great powers situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Samanumu — wary tribal confederation of the synthesis; kinship, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Samanumu are a warlike tribal confederation people, a first-order synthesis of Thiodons and Wendaki [Confederated Peoples]. They prize kinship, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field heavy_cavalry, heavy_infantry, archers. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch war.
